title: Badge
description: A compact status label in five tones, with a matching status icon and a subtle tinted style.

props.name: tone
props.description: Meaning of the label. Every tone except neutral shows its status icon.

props.name: showIcon
props.description: Hide the status icon when space is tight; the text must still carry the meaning.

a11y: Meaning never relies on color alone: each status tone pairs its color with an icon and the text.
Icons are aria-hidden; the visible text is the accessible name.
Tone colors meet WCAG AA contrast against their foreground token in light and dark themes.
docs:
Installed `Badge`. Import it from `@/components/ui/badge`.

Tones: neutral, info, success, warning, danger. Success and warning use the badge's own variables (`--badge-success`, `--badge-warning` and their foregrounds, light and dark); every other color comes from your theme.
